user.description: Stop the MQTT bridge and close the Soma app first: a shade with a connection is not visible.

abort.no_devices_found: No shades found. A shade is only visible without a connection, and within range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

data_description.show_as_tilt: Turned off, the Tilt is a cover with a position instead of a tilt position, for e.g. a remote that does not support tilt. The values stay the same: closed downwards at 0, open at 50 and closed upwards at 100.
